itinerary_days.theme: Arrival, The Bund Promenade & Monday-Safe Art + MICHELIN Dining
itinerary_days.calendar_alert: Normal workday Monday (Spring Festival holiday ended Sat Feb 13; Sun Feb 14 was make-up workday). CLOSED TODAY: Yu Garden, Shanghai Museum People's Square, Power Station of Art, Da Vittorio, Taian Table, Sir Elly's, and (potentially) T'ang Court.
itinerary_days.morning: Arrive PVG → 8-min Shanghai Maglev (CNY 50/pp, tap Visa/Mastercard at gate, or CNY 55 Maglev + 24h Metro Pass) to Longyang Rd → Metro Line 2/10 to Xintiandi or Bund hotel check-in / bag drop.
itinerary_days.afternoon: Walk The Bund Heritage Promenade (open 24h, CNY 0) → cross via Line 2 to Museum of Art Pudong (MAP, OPEN MONDAYS 10:00–21:00, Sunset Mirror Hall facing the Bund).
itinerary_days.evening: Monday-open MICHELIN Dinner: Yi Long Court (1★ Cantonese at The Peninsula, Tasting CNY 2,304/2 or à la carte, open daily 18:00–22:30) OR Mr & Mrs Bund (MICHELIN Selected, PP Classic Sharing Dinner CNY 2,834/2, open daily 17:30–22:00).

itinerary_days.theme: Classical Yu Garden, Plane-Tree Lanes & French/Italian Stars
itinerary_days.calendar_alert: CLOSED TUESDAYS: Shanghai Museum East & Sir Elly's (dinner). Yu Garden, French Concession & Da Vittorio ARE OPEN!
itinerary_days.morning: 09:00 Yu Garden Daytime Entry (Off-peak CNY 60 for 2, Tue–Sun 09:00–16:30, last entry 16:00; Line 10/14 Yuyuan Garden) + local pan-fried bun snack at Da Hu Chun (Bib Gourmand, ¥, open 08:00–21:00).
itinerary_days.afternoon: Line 10 to Jiaotong University / Shanghai Library → stroll Wukang Mansion, Wukang Road & Anfu Road in the Former French Concession.
itinerary_days.evening: Starred European Dinner: Da Vittorio Shanghai (2★ Italian at BFC, Tue–Sun 18:00–21:30) OR Le Comptoir de Pierre Gagnaire (1★ French at Capella Jian Ye Li, CNY 2,284–4,556/2 à la carte, daily 18:00–20:30).

itinerary_days.theme: Shanghai Museum East Masterpieces, 632m Sky Deck & 2★ Dim Sum
itinerary_days.calendar_alert: Shanghai Museum East reopens Wednesday (10:00–18:00); Sir Elly's rooftop reopens Wednesday (18:00–22:30).
itinerary_days.morning: 10:00 The Shanghai Museum East (1952 Century Ave, Pudong — FREE, no individual reservation needed, bring US passports to B1 East Gate; Bronze, Jade, Ceramics & Painting galleries).
itinerary_days.afternoon: Lunch at T'ang Court (2★ Cantonese at Langham Xintiandi — verified Dim Sum Lunch Set CNY 888 for 2 incl. tax/service!) → late-afternoon Top of Shanghai 118F Observatory (CNY 360 for 2).
itinerary_days.evening: Bund Rooftop or Skyline Dinner: Sir Elly's Restaurant (MICHELIN Selected, 13F Peninsula, 5-course CNY 3,004/2 incl. 16.6%, Wed–Sun) OR Jin Xuan (1★ Cantonese, 53F Ritz-Carlton Pudong).

itinerary_days.theme: Contemporary Riverfront Art, 2★ Thu–Sun Lunch & Sole 3★ Counter
itinerary_days.calendar_alert: 8½ Otto e Mezzo Bombana's lunch service operates Thu–Sun ONLY (12:00–13:30) — Thursday is first lunch day!
itinerary_days.morning: Power Station of Art (PSA, Tue–Sun 11:00–19:00, CNY 0 permanent space) along the Huangpu South Bund.
itinerary_days.afternoon: Thursday-Unlocked Lunch at 8½ Otto e Mezzo Bombana (2★ Italian, Rockbund) OR Creative Dim Sum Set for Two at Sui Tang Li (MICHELIN Selected, Jing'an, CNY 988 for 2 w/ 24h notice).
itinerary_days.evening: Flagship 3★ Degustation: Taian Table (Shanghai's ONLY 3-Star restaurant, Changning, Tue–Sat 18:00–20:00 counter seating; RMB 4,000 deposit for 2).

itinerary_days.theme: Weekday Canal Town OR Shanghai Disneyland (Pre-Weekend Low Queues)
itinerary_days.calendar_alert: Friday beats Saturday's Lantern Festival crowds at both Zhujiajiao and Shanghai Disneyland.
itinerary_days.morning: Choice A (Heritage): Metro Line 10 → Line 17 to Zhujiajiao Ancient Water Town (scenic combo CNY 120 for 2, canal bridges & Kezhi Garden). Choice B (Modern): Metro Line 11 to Shanghai Disneyland (from CNY 950 for 2; Zootopia & TRON).
itinerary_days.afternoon: Continue canal boat / tea houses in Zhujiajiao OR afternoon attractions at Shanghai Disneyland.
itinerary_days.evening: Relaxed Xintiandi Bistro Dinner: Polux by Paul Pairet (Bib Gourmand French Café, Xintiandi terrace) OR Rong Cuisine (Bib Gourmand Taizhou seafood, walk-in couple table).

itinerary_days.day: Day 6 · Sat Feb 20, 2027 (Lantern Festival / 元宵节!)
itinerary_days.theme: 2★ Zen Vegetarian Lunch, Huangpu River Cruise & Lantern Festival Night
itinerary_days.calendar_alert: 15th day of the First Lunar Month (Lantern Festival)! Yuyuan Night Tour runs Fri–Sun 18:00–21:20 — book timed entry early!
itinerary_days.morning: The Shanghai Museum on People's Square (09:00–17:00, last entry 15:00 — special 'Ancient Civilizations of the Americas' exhibition).
itinerary_days.afternoon: 2★ Lunch at Fu He Hui (2★ Vegetarian Zen sets, Changning, 11:00–13:00) OR Canton 8 Runan St (2★ Cantonese at ¥¥ moderate band) → late-afternoon Huangpu River Cruise (CNY 240 for 2 daytime classic).
itinerary_days.evening: Lantern Festival Celebration at Yuyuan Old Street & Yu Garden Night Tour ('Yu Xiang Shan Lin' light show, Fri–Sun 18:00–21:20) + late-night Neo-Chinese tasting at Ling Long (1★, Waldorf Bund, open until 01:00).

itinerary_days.theme: Bund Terrace Brunch, Shikumen Lanes & Suhe Creek 2★ Finale
itinerary_days.calendar_alert: Taian Table is closed Sundays; Bao Li Xuan, Yi Long Court, Mr & Mrs Bund, and Ling Long are open.
itinerary_days.morning: Leisurely morning in Xintiandi Shikumen alleys & Jing'an parks.
itinerary_days.afternoon: Weekend Bund Terrace Brunch at Mr & Mrs Bund (CNY 990 for 2 incl. 10%) OR Dim Sum Lunch at Yi Long Court (1★, CNY 695–788 for 2 incl. 16.6%).
itinerary_days.evening: Farewell Gala Dinner at Bao Li Xuan (2★ Cantonese in historic 1916 Chamber of Commerce at Bvlgari Hotel — verified Set Menu CNY 3,576 for 2 incl. service & tax).

itinerary_days.day: Day 8 · Mon Feb 22, 2027 (Departure or Extension Pivot)
itinerary_days.theme: Express Maglev Departure OR 10/14-Night Hangzhou/Suzhou HSR Extension
itinerary_days.calendar_alert: If extending to 10 nights (Feb 25) or 14 nights (Mar 1), depart Shanghai Hongqiao via 45-min HSR to Hangzhou (13★ MICHELIN venues + West Lake).
itinerary_days.morning: Hotel breakfast & check-out → Metro Line 2 to Longyang Rd → 8-min Maglev (CNY 50/pp) to PVG Terminal 1/2 (or 40-min Airport Link Line CNY 26 between SHA & PVG).
itinerary_days.afternoon: Onward flight (to 3rd country/region if using 240h Visa-Free Transit, or direct US return if holding Chinese L-Visa).

airport_transit.route: Pudong Int'l Airport (PVG) ↔ Longyang Rd (interchange w/ Metro Lines 2, 7, 16, 18)
airport_transit.fare_per_person: CNY 50 single · CNY 80 round-trip · CNY 40 w/ same-day boarding pass · CNY 55 Maglev + 24h Metro Pass
airport_transit.couple_total: CNY 100 single (CNY 80 w/ boarding pass) · CNY 110 w/ two 24h Metro passes
airport_transit.payment_note: Tap foreign Visa, Mastercard, JCB, Diners, UnionPay directly at Maglev turnstiles, or Alipay/WeChat.

airport_transit.mode: Suburban Railway Airport Link Line (PVG ↔ SHA)
airport_transit.route: Pudong T1&T2 ↔ Resort East ↔ Zhangjiang ↔ Sanlin South ↔ Jinghong Rd ↔ Qibao ↔ Hongqiao T2
airport_transit.payment_note: Note from Shmetro: for Shanghai Disneyland from downtown, take Metro Line 11 to Disney Resort station rather than Resort East on Airport Link Line.

airport_transit.route: Line 2 connects PVG ↔ Lujiazui ↔ East Nanjing Rd (Bund) ↔ People's Sq ↔ West Nanjing Rd ↔ Jing'an Temple ↔ Jiangsu Rd ↔ SHA
airport_transit.travel_time: Official operating speed 35–40 km/h (~2–3 min per urban station); PVG to East Nanjing Rd ~60–65 min; SHA to Xintiandi (Line 10) ~30–35 min
airport_transit.fare_per_person: CNY 3 (0–6 km) · CNY 4 (6–16 km) · +CNY 1 per 10 km >16 km · 1-Day Pass CNY 18 · 3-Day Pass CNY 45
airport_transit.couple_total: CNY 6–8 per central ride for 2 · CNY 90 for two 72-hour Unlimited Metro Passes
airport_transit.payment_note: Link Visa/Mastercard inside Alipay ('Transport' QR) or purchase 1-Day/3-Day passes at station service centers.

cluster_routes.metro_lines: Line 10 Xintiandi → Jiaotong Univ → Line 11 Jiangsu Rd (4 stops total)
cluster_routes.estimated_window: ~18–25 min rail + 3–8 min walk (well under ≤1h threshold)

cluster_routes.origin_cluster: Xintiandi (#1 Langham · #2 Andaz) or Bund (#5 EDITION)
cluster_routes.destination: Lujiazui & Pudong Cultural Axis (1★ Jin Xuan, Shanghai Tower, MAP, Shanghai Museum East)
cluster_routes.metro_lines: Line 14 direct Xintiandi → Lujiazui (3 stops) OR Line 2 East Nanjing Rd → Lujiazui (1 stop) / Sci & Tech Museum (4 stops)
cluster_routes.verification_note: Exit 8 at Shanghai Science & Technology Museum verified on shanghaimuseum.net.

cluster_routes.destination: Xuhui French Concession (1★ Pierre Gagnaire, Wukang Mansion)
cluster_routes.metro_lines: Line 7 direct Jing'an Temple → Zhaojiabang Rd (3 stops) or Changshu Rd (1 stop)
cluster_routes.verification_note: Direct north-south Line 7 link across central Puxi.

cluster_routes.metro_lines: Line 10 → Line 11 Disney Resort Terminus (~48–55 min) · Line 10 → Line 17 Zhujiajiao (~58–65 min)
cluster_routes.estimated_window: ~50–65 min rail (sits right at the ~1h outer boundary — flagged in F16)
